mcp.note: Tavily's MCP server answers initialize with 401, so its tools/list can't be fetched. Captured once on 2026-11-17 with a free-tier API key, sent as the bearer token the connector itself uses; the server advertises its own OAuth authorization server, but accepts an API key. It answers over server-sent events, so a capture takes the JSON out of the data: frame. Refreshing it means capturing it again with a key.
